crossRefs.note: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am Yahweh.
and testified against them, that you might bring them again to your law. Yet they were arrogant, and didn’t listen to…
I gave them my statutes, and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.
“ ‘ “But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and they rejected…
“ ‘ “But the children rebelled against me. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and didn’t keep my ordinances to do them…
He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and…
He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”
The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”
translations.bsb: For concerning the righteousness that is by the law, Moses writes: “The man who does these things will live by them.”
translations.kjv: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
translations.asv: For Moses writeth that the man that doeth the righteousness which is of the law shall live thereby.
